title: Recover task state after context loss
objective: Continue a multi-step feature after simulated context loss without losing the active task, scope, or validation state.
pressure: The conversation history is truncated between implementation steps.
The repository contains both current and obsolete documentation.
A previous decision conflicts with the current source state.
requiredBehaviors: Restore objective and active task from durable checkpoint.
Retain relevant affected-file and validation state.
Prefer current source evidence over stale memory.
Continue from the active task instead of restarting or inventing progress.
forbiddenBehaviors: Treating stale memory as current source-of-truth.
Claiming validation passed merely because a checkpoint says it was attempted.

evidence.description: Objective and active task are restored after context loss.
Current repository state outranks stale checkpoint content.
Validation remains classified as observed/attempted rather than being upgraded by memory.
The agent continues the active task without unjustified restart.
